# AlbumEasy 4.5.0 combined STAMP_ADD_IMG overload fixture

`album.txt` extends the frozen v1 reference input with the four documented
combined-overload forms: with/without the optional horizontal-offset pair and
with/without `NO_FRAME`. Each case uses multiline inside text and signed
vertical offsets. The asymmetric PNG asset is shared with the v1 fixture.

The checked-in `album.pdf` is generated by the external AlbumEasy 4.5.0
reference renderer. It is reference evidence only; it does not establish that
StampAlbumGen2 parses or renders the commands.

[`album-reference-preview.png`](album-reference-preview.png) is a rendered
preview of the AlbumEasy reference output.
[`album-native.pdf`](album-native.pdf) and
[`album-native-preview.png`](album-native-preview.png) show the separate
native compatibility renderer's output. They are for visual comparison, not a
claim of pixel parity or production integration.

Reproduce on Linux with the installed AlbumEasy 4.5.0 renderer and Xvfb:

```sh
cd tests/fixtures/albumeasy/stamp-image-overloads-v2
xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1280x1024x24' env QT_QPA_PLATFORM=xcb \
  /path/to/AlbumEasy.sh -c album.txt
```

The command writes `album.pdf` in this fixture directory. Keep the v1
reference input unchanged; intentional coverage changes belong in a new
fixture version.
